result.summary: This is a wide residential street with sidewalks on both sides, bordering a large park area. The environment lacks marked crossings and traffic calming measures, resulting in long, unprotected crossing distances for pedestrians accessing the park.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The excessive width of the street without lane markings or traffic calming encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases pedestrian exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway extending into the background

hazards.name: Lack of Controlled Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or signs to facilitate safe crossing between the residential area and the park.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible length of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to define pedestrian paths across the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical deflection measures to reduce vehicle speeds on this wide residential corridor.

result.summary: The image shows a one-way street adjacent to a park with a significantly degraded sidewalk. There is a complete lack of formal crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps, at this location.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk is cracked, uneven, and has vegetation growing through it, creating a significant trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground along the park edge

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramp
hazards.description: There is no sloped transition from the sidewalk to the street, making the path inaccessible for people with mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: At the edge of the sidewalk where a crossing would occur

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the existing sidewalk to provide a smooth, continuous walking surface.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramp Installation
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at potential crossing points.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to define a safe crossing path and alert drivers.
